manifest.name: dsh-to-figma
manifest.description: DSH to Figma — native canvas editing, design context, assets and screenshots for DeepSeek Harness.

scripts.test:all: npm run check && npm test && npm run test:native

manifest.author: Duoasa

bundle.text:
- insert:
    - id: dsh-figma
      name: 'dsh-to-figma'
      config:
        backend: local
        bridgePort: 3055

readme.text:
<div align="center">

<sub>DSH to Figma 0.3.5 · 标题设计与原生动画</sub>

**用自然语言读懂、创建和修改 Figma 设计。** 连接 DeepSeek Harness 与 Figma，把需求、参考图和设计稿变成可以继续编辑的画布。 [](https://github.com/Duoasa/DSH-to-Figma/releases/latest) [](LICENSE) [](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/blob/main/data/plugins/Duoasa__DSH-to-Figma.yml) **简体中文** · [English](README.en.md) · [日本語](README.ja.md) [提示词安装](#安装把下面这段话发给-dsh) · [能做什么](#能做什么) · [实机演示](#实机演示) · [手动安装](#手动安装)
**本地模式不消耗官方 Figma MCP 调用额度。** DSH 会自动生成本机已配对的 Figma 插件，首次导入一次，之后运行即可连接。

| 新功能 | 你可以做什么 |
| --- | --- |
| 原生动效 | 创建和调整关键帧、文字入场与动画样式，继续在 Figma 时间线中编辑 |
| 断线重连 | 根据原生文件身份识别重连目标，确认后恢复操作，避免误操作其他文件 |
| 能力检测 | 操作前确认当前编辑器支持什么，明确提示不可用的功能 |
| 内置使用指南 | 直接问 DSH 如何连接、使用或排错，自动查阅对应章节 |
| 界面与兼容性 | 更新插件图标和紧凑界面，延续宽松的宿主兼容范围，不锁定单个 RC |

动效功能以当前编辑器开放的 API 为准。断线后需要重新确认目标文件，未完成的操作不会自动重放。

已通过 DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5 与 0.2.2-rc.1 的兼容性验证。

**升级要点：** 同步更新 DSH 包与 Figma 配套插件，运行 `figma_setup` 后关闭并重新打开 Local 插件。通过 `figma_status` 确认 DSH 端与配套插件均为 0.3.5。

readme.section: 安装：把下面这段话发给 DSH
readme.text:
推荐直接让 DSH 完成下载、校验和安装。打开当前使用的 DSH，复制发送：

```text
帮我安装或升级 DSH to Figma：
https://github.com/Duoasa/DSH-to-Figma

请按仓库最新 README 完成以下操作：

首次连接时，在 Figma 桌面端选择 **Plugins → Development → Import plugin from manifest…**，导入 DSH 给出的 `manifest.json`。在目标文件中运行 **DSH to Figma · Local**，保持插件窗口打开即可。

通常路径为 `~/.dsh/figma/companion/manifest.json`，以 `figma_setup` 返回的路径为准。升级后，两端插件需要同步更新；保留原导入目录，关闭并重新运行 Figma 插件。

| 需求 | 使用方式 |
| --- | --- |
| 读懂已有设计 | 读取选中画板、图层结构、文字、尺寸、布局、样式与截图 |
| 从需求或参考图开始 | 创建原生画板、文字、矢量和自动布局，继续细化设计 |
| 调整与批量修改 | 修改文案、颜色、字号、间距、圆角和布局，按名称、属性或层级定位图层 |
| 组件与设计系统 | 创建和修改组件、变体、实例属性、样式、变量、模式及别名，绑定设计变量 |
| 设计稿到代码 | 让 DSH 结合画板信息、素材和当前项目生成或调整前端页面 |
| 素材交付 | 导入图片和 SVG，导出 PNG、JPG、SVG、PDF，保存脚本生成的文件 |
| FigJam、Slides 与交互 | 结合目标文件类型，组织图形、连接线、演示内容和原型交互 |

你可以直接这样说：

> 读取选中的设置页，把主按钮统一为 40px 高、8px 圆角，调整后给我截图。

> 复用已有颜色变量和按钮组件，新建一个浅色仪表盘，用自动布局组织内容。

> 为这个按钮补充悬停和禁用状态，并把颜色绑定到对应的语义变量。

> 参考这张截图，在新画板中重建界面，文字和布局保留为可编辑图层。

> 读取这个画板，在当前项目中实现页面，复用项目已有组件，并把所需素材导出到资源目录。

插件负责连接画布与工具，具体设计方案由你使用的模型结合需求完成。可以继续通过对话修改，也可以回到 Figma 手动调整。
**DSH to Figma 0.3.5 支持下方演示的完整制作流程。** 从参考图重建可编辑画板，再用一句话添加原生动画；顶部动图展示了最终效果。模型：GPT-6-Astra High，2026 年 11 月 4 日。

readme.section: 1. 发图描述需求，再继续做动画
readme.text:
> 把这张图复刻到 figma 的当前画板上。
>
> 用这个画板做个 figma 动画。

readme.section: 2. 得到可继续编辑的 Figma 图层
readme.text: 2172 × 724 的画板中，文字、Logo、图形和连线分别保留为可编辑图层。

readme.section: 3. 在时间线中继续调整动画
readme.text: 8 秒循环、32 条动画轨道：标题依次入场，图块轻微悬浮，结尾淡出。顶部 GIF 由 Figma 导出。

readme.section: 进阶案例：更强模型，复刻复杂界面
readme.text:
**当 DSH 接入更强的模型时，DSH to Figma 可以承载更复杂的界面复刻，呈现更精细的布局与细节。** 插件提供画布读写能力，模型负责理解参考图、拆解界面并逐步完成设计。

这组截图来自 2026 年 11 月 3 日的实际使用，DSH 中显示的模型为 **GPT-6-Astra Max**。输入一张 tweakcn 主题编辑器截图，并提出：

> 在目前开启的 figma 画板上复刻这个 UI

结果在 Figma 中呈现为 **2264 × 1308** 的画板，包含主题编辑区、股票图表、交易卡片、活动列表和聊天面板。左侧图层面板可见独立的文字与分组；DSH 返回说明中记录，主体 UI 的文字、图标和图表均可继续编辑。

<details>
<summary>查看 DSH 中的参考图、指令与返回结果</summary>

</details>

本案例展示了更强模型在复杂界面任务中的应用效果。最终校对时曾断开 Figma 连接，少量文字间距修正尚未确认，仍可继续在画布中细化。

从 [最新 Release](https://github.com/Duoasa/DSH-to-Figma/releases/latest) 下载 DSH 安装包与 `SHA256SUMS`，校验后使用当前宿主的 CLI 安装。

**macOS DSH Desktop：**

> **桌面版请使用下面的应用内置 CLI 完整路径。** 全局 `dsh` 操作 `desktop` profile 可能报 `managed exclusively by the Electron application`。遇到该提示，请改用内置 CLI；不要删除或重建 desktop profile。

```sh
"/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" \
  plugin --profile desktop add "file:/绝对路径/dsh-to-figma-0.3.5.tgz"
```

**其他 DSH 宿主：**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的-profile> add "file:/绝对路径/dsh-to-figma-0.3.5.tgz"
```

把路径和 profile 替换为实际值。桌面版使用应用自带 CLI；其他宿主按实际 profile 安装。安装后在插件面板确认 **DSH to Figma → 运行中**，再让 DSH 调用 `figma_setup` 完成配对。

DSH 会生成已经配对的 Figma 插件，日常安装不需要额外下载 ZIP。Release 中的 `DSH-to-Figma-companion-0.3.5.zip` 是手动配对备用包。DSH 在本机生成的已配对目录与 ZIP 含配对凭证，请保留在本机；Release 中的通用 ZIP 不含凭证。

默认使用 `local` 模式：DSH 与 Figma 配套插件通过本机服务连接。单文件连接后自动选用，多文件时明确选择操作目标。

| 配置项 | 默认值 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `backend` | `local` | 选择 `local`、`desktop` 或 `remote` |
| `bridgePort` | `3055` | 本地连接端口 |
| `toolCallTimeoutMs` | `120000` | 单次工具调用超时，单位毫秒 |
| `desktopServerUrl` | `http://127.0.0.1:3845/mcp` | 桌面 MCP 地址 |
| `oauthClientId` | 空 | 远程登录所需的客户端配置 |

通过宿主插件管理器调整配置。[详细接入与配置说明](docs/setup.md)。

如果升级后未发现工具，先确认正在使用正确的宿主和 profile，检查插件面板，再重载或重启 DSH。Figma 端也要关闭旧插件后重新运行。反馈问题时请附上两端版本和错误信息。

```sh
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run test:all
npm run package:companion
npm pack --ignore-scripts

源码包括 DSH 插件入口、连接桥接、Figma companion 和工作流 Skill。欢迎提交改进建议或可复现的问题。

感谢 [heeq666](https://github.com/heeq666) 与 [miztizm](https://github.com/miztizm) 对宿主兼容性的反馈和贡献。

基于 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)、[Figma Plugin API](https://developers.figma.com/docs/plugins/) 和 [Model Context Protocol SDK](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/typescript-sdk) 构建。

<div align="center">

<sub>DSH to Figma 0.3.5 · Title design and native animation</sub>

**Read, create and edit Figma designs with natural language.**

Connect DeepSeek Harness to Figma and turn briefs, reference images and existing designs into editable canvas content.

[](https://github.com/Duoasa/DSH-to-Figma/releases/latest)
[](LICENSE)
[](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

[简体中文](README.md) · **English** · [日本語](README.ja.md)

[Install with a prompt](#install-with-a-prompt) · [Features](#features) · [In action](#in-action) · [Manual installation](#manual-installation) **Local mode does not consume the official Figma MCP call quota.** DSH generates a paired Figma companion for your computer. Import it once, then run it to connect.

| Feature | What you can do |
| --- | --- |
| Native motion | Create and edit keyframes, text entrances and animation styles; refine them in Figma’s timeline |
| Reconnect recovery | Identify reconnect candidates by native file identity, then confirm the target before resuming |
| Capability checks | Check what the current editor supports before an operation |
| Built-in help | Ask DSH about setup, usage or errors; it consults the relevant guide |
| UI and compatibility | Updated icon and compact UI; broad host compatibility without a single-RC lock |

Motion depends on APIs exposed by the editor. After a disconnect, confirm the target file again; interrupted operations are not replayed automatically.

Compatibility verified with DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5 and 0.2.2-rc.1.

**Upgrading:** Update both the DSH package and Figma companion, run `figma_setup`, then close and reopen Local. Use `figma_status` to confirm that both the DSH plugin and companion report 0.3.5.

Send this to the DSH host you currently use:

```text
Install or update DSH to Figma for me:
https://github.com/Duoasa/DSH-to-Figma

Follow the latest repository README:

In Figma Desktop, choose **Plugins → Development → Import plugin from manifest…** and select the generated manifest. Run **DSH to Figma · Local** in your target file and keep its window open.

The usual path is `~/.dsh/figma/companion/manifest.json`; use the exact path returned by `figma_setup`. Update both plugins together. Keep the imported folder in place and close/reopen the companion after an update.

| Task | Workflow |
| --- | --- |
| Understand an existing design | Read selections, layers, text, dimensions, layout, styles and screenshots |
| Start from a brief or reference | Create native frames, text, vectors and auto layout, then refine them |
| Edit in batches | Change copy, colors, typography, spacing, corners and layout; locate layers by name, properties or hierarchy |
| Build a design system | Create and edit components, variants, instance properties, styles, variables, modes, aliases and bindings |
| Turn designs into code | Let DSH combine design context, assets and your existing project to implement or revise frontend pages |
| Deliver assets | Import images/SVG; export PNG, JPG, SVG and PDF; save script-generated files |
| Work across document types | Organize FigJam diagrams, Slides content and prototype interactions |

Try prompts such as:

> Make the primary buttons in this artboard 40px tall with an 8px corner radius, then show me a screenshot.

> Reuse the existing color variables and button components to create a light dashboard with auto layout.

> Add hover and disabled variants to this button and bind their colors to semantic variables.

> Rebuild this reference image on a new artboard with editable text and layout.

> Implement this artboard in the current project, reusing existing components and exporting the required assets.

The plugin connects the model to the canvas and tools. Continue refining the result through conversation or edit it directly in Figma.

**DSH to Figma 0.3.5 supports the complete workflow demonstrated below.** Recreate a reference as editable layers, then add native animation with a follow-up request. The header GIF shows the result. Model: GPT-6-Astra High, November 4, 2026.

readme.section: 1. Share a reference, then ask for motion
readme.text:
> Recreate this image on the current Figma artboard.
>
> Make a Figma animation using this artboard.
The 2172 × 724 artboard keeps text, logos, shapes and connectors as separate editable layers.
An 8-second loop with 32 tracks: staggered title entrances, floating tiles and a fade-out. The header GIF was exported from Figma.

readme.section: Advanced example: a stronger model for a complex UI
readme.text:
**Connecting DSH to a stronger model can help DSH to Figma handle more complex UI recreations with finer layout and detail.** The plugin provides canvas access; the model interprets the reference, breaks down the interface and builds the design step by step.

These screenshots come from actual use on November 3, 2026, with **GPT-6-Astra Max** displayed as the selected model in DSH. A screenshot of the tweakcn theme editor was supplied with this request:

readme.section: Advanced example: a stronger model for a complex UI
readme.text:
> Recreate this UI on the Figma artboard currently open.

The result is a **2264 × 1308** Figma frame containing a theme editor, stock chart, transaction cards, activity feed and chat panel. Separate text layers and groups are visible in the Layers panel; the DSH response reports that the main UI's text, icons and charts remain editable.

<details>
<summary>See the reference, instruction and response in DSH</summary>

</details>

readme.section: Advanced example: a stronger model for a complex UI
readme.text: This example illustrates how a stronger model can be used for a complex UI task. Figma disconnected during the final review, leaving a few text-spacing adjustments unconfirmed; the design can be refined further on the canvas.

Download the DSH package and `SHA256SUMS` from the [latest Release](https://github.com/Duoasa/DSH-to-Figma/releases/latest), verify the checksum, then use your host's CLI.

**macOS DSH Desktop:**

> **Use the full bundled CLI path below for Desktop.** A global `dsh` command may reject the `desktop` profile with `managed exclusively by the Electron application`. Switch to the bundled CLI; do not delete or recreate the desktop profile.

```sh
"/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" \
  plugin --profile desktop add "file:/absolute/path/dsh-to-figma-0.3.5.tgz"
```

**Other DSH hosts:**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add "file:/absolute/path/dsh-to-figma-0.3.5.tgz"
```

Replace the path and profile. Use the desktop app's bundled CLI for the desktop profile. Confirm **DSH to Figma → Running** in the plugin panel, then call `figma_setup`.

The usual workflow uses the companion generated by DSH. `DSH-to-Figma-companion-0.3.5.zip` is an alternative for manual pairing. Keep generated paired folders and ZIPs private because they contain local pairing credentials.
The default `local` backend connects DSH and the companion through a local service. A single file is selected automatically; select the target explicitly when several are connected.

| Setting | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `backend` | `local` | `local`, `desktop` or `remote` |
| `bridgePort` | `3055` | Local connection port |
| `toolCallTimeoutMs` | `120000` | Tool call timeout in milliseconds |
| `desktopServerUrl` | `http://127.0.0.1:3845/mcp` | Desktop MCP address |
| `oauthClientId` | Empty | Remote login client configuration |

Change these in the host's plugin settings. See [setup details](docs/setup.md).

If tools disappear after an upgrade, check the host, profile and plugin panel, then reload or restart DSH. Also close and rerun the Figma companion. Include both plugin versions and the error when reporting a problem.

```sh
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run test:all
npm run package:companion
npm pack --ignore-scripts

The source includes the DSH entry point, connection bridge, Figma companion and workflow skill. Contributions and reproducible issue reports are welcome.

Thanks to [heeq666](https://github.com/heeq666) and [miztizm](https://github.com/miztizm) for host compatibility feedback and contributions.

Built with [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness), the [Figma Plugin API](https://developers.figma.com/docs/plugins/) and the [Model Context Protocol SDK](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/typescript-sdk).

**DSH to Figma 0.3.5 支持下方演示的完整制作流程。** 从参考图重建可编辑画板，再用一句话添加原生动画；顶部动图展示了最终效果。模型：GPT-6-Astra High，2026 年 11 月 4 日。

readme.section: 进阶案例：更强模型，复刻复杂界面
readme.text:
**当 DSH 接入更强的模型时，DSH to Figma 可以承载更复杂的界面复刻，呈现更精细的布局与细节。** 插件提供画布读写能力，模型负责理解参考图、拆解界面并逐步完成设计。

这组截图来自 2026 年 11 月 3 日的实际使用，DSH 中显示的模型为 **GPT-6-Astra Max**。输入一张 tweakcn 主题编辑器截图，并提出：

> 在目前开启的 figma 画板上复刻这个 UI

结果在 Figma 中呈现为 **2264 × 1308** 的画板，包含主题编辑区、股票图表、交易卡片、活动列表和聊天面板。左侧图层面板可见独立的文字与分组；DSH 返回说明中记录，主体 UI 的文字、图标和图表均可继续编辑。

<details>
<summary>查看 DSH 中的参考图、指令与返回结果</summary>

</details>

本案例展示了更强模型在复杂界面任务中的应用效果。最终校对时曾断开 Figma 连接，少量文字间距修正尚未确认，仍可继续在画布中细化。

从 [最新 Release](https://github.com/Duoasa/DSH-to-Figma/releases/latest) 下载 DSH 安装包与 `SHA256SUMS`，校验后使用当前宿主的 CLI 安装。

**macOS DSH Desktop：**

> **桌面版请使用下面的应用内置 CLI 完整路径。** 全局 `dsh` 操作 `desktop` profile 可能报 `managed exclusively by the Electron application`。遇到该提示，请改用内置 CLI；不要删除或重建 desktop profile。

```sh
"/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" \
  plugin --profile desktop add "file:/绝对路径/dsh-to-figma-0.3.5.tgz"
```

**其他 DSH 宿主：**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的-profile> add "file:/绝对路径/dsh-to-figma-0.3.5.tgz"
```

把路径和 profile 替换为实际值。桌面版使用应用自带 CLI；其他宿主按实际 profile 安装。安装后在插件面板确认 **DSH to Figma → 运行中**，再让 DSH 调用 `figma_setup` 完成配对。

DSH 会生成已经配对的 Figma 插件，日常安装不需要额外下载 ZIP。Release 中的 `DSH-to-Figma-companion-0.3.5.zip` 是手动配对备用包。DSH 在本机生成的已配对目录与 ZIP 含配对凭证，请保留在本机；Release 中的通用 ZIP 不含凭证。

默认使用 `local` 模式：DSH 与 Figma 配套插件通过本机服务连接。单文件连接后自动选用，多文件时明确选择操作目标。

| 配置项 | 默认值 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `backend` | `local` | 选择 `local`、`desktop` 或 `remote` |
| `bridgePort` | `3055` | 本地连接端口 |
| `toolCallTimeoutMs` | `120000` | 单次工具调用超时，单位毫秒 |
| `desktopServerUrl` | `http://127.0.0.1:3845/mcp` | 桌面 MCP 地址 |
| `oauthClientId` | 空 | 远程登录所需的客户端配置 |

通过宿主插件管理器调整配置。[详细接入与配置说明](docs/setup.md)。

如果升级后未发现工具，先确认正在使用正确的宿主和 profile，检查插件面板，再重载或重启 DSH。Figma 端也要关闭旧插件后重新运行。反馈问题时请附上两端版本和错误信息。

```sh
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run test:all
npm run package:companion
npm pack --ignore-scripts
